purpose: Check specific original data license, accessible files and pre-response exposure/feedback variables before obtaining person-level datasets
test: One read-only GitHub hosted runner, max 3 minutes; retrieve Dataverse API metadata only. Return license, dataset version and file names/sizes/restriction flags; never download identifiable forecasts, even if CC0. Optionally fetch only an unrestricted README <=256 KiB under verified CC0 and compute full-byte SHA256.
negative_controls: Missing or customized license blocks reuse
No URL access workaround or CAPTCHA bypass
No personal records in logs or repo

scientific_gate.estimand: Effect of assigned leaderboard visibility on attempts per logged person-question opportunity; accuracy separate
scientific_gate.treatment: Randomized or plausibly identified feedback assignment before responding
scientific_gate.denominator: Pre-response opportunity exposure E_iqt must be independently observed; posted question != visible to person
scientific_gate.decision: STOP_R5 and keep both AB-H legacy slots if rights, exposure or discriminating contrast missing
